findings.finding: data/master.json holds 354 rows; 1 are placeholder 'No fixture' rows, 208 are dated before today (2026-10-24), 67 are marked build_verified=false, and 0 High-confidence rows carry no prediction text.

data/master.json declares generated_on 2026-10-21; its row dates run past that stamp, so the file is a merged build rather than a single dated desk. Readers should treat the date column, not generated_on, as the fixture date.

Boards FB/EZ/BN grade their top five rows per sport as 'High' from a composite index, not from the brief's ≥70% probability test; published examples sit at 55–69% (e.g. FB-PRED-01 is p=0.5942, −146). Their High labels are therefore not comparable with the High labels on this desk, which enforce ≥70% and the −250…+10,000 window together.

Several session desks publish fixture rows whose start time has already passed relative to the repository snapshot (2026-10-24T15:56Z), including golf and darts rows dated 24 Oct. This desk rebuilds its window from a fresh capture instead of carrying them, and lists them here rather than editing another owner's file.
